Accessibility ebook

Accessibility support often overlaps with many other best practices brands should consider when creating digital products, including improved semantic content, usability, mobile optimization and SEO (Search Engine Optimization).

That’s why we’ve partnered with Seer Interactive for the 10th Anniversary of Global Accessibility Awareness Day on May 20th, 2021 to produce an e-book to help businesses better understand the positive impact accessibility considerations have when websites and digital experiences are designed to be accessible to ALL users.

What you’ll learn from this e-book:

  • 13 tips on how to make your site more accessible while having a positive impact on SEO
  • 4 useful UX and technical audit tools
  • 3 ways to prioritize known accessibility issues
  • 2 recommendations for remediating issues and validating improvements

Learn how accessibility can enhance SEO
